AGENDA
  GLENDALE AUDIT COMMITTEE
  VIA TELECONFERENCE AND COUNCIL CHAMBERS (STAFF ACCESS ONLY)
  613 E. Broadway, 2nd Floor
  Glendale, CA 91206
 Welcome to the Glendale Audit Committee meeting. Meetings are broadcast on Spectrum Cable,
 channel 6, AT&T U-verse, channel 99, and streaming live in high definition (HD) on the city's
 webpage, glendaleca.gov/live. In addition, city meetings are available on YouTube.com/myglendale
 and on Apple TV, Roku, and Amazon Fire devices using a free app called Screenweave and
 choosing “Glendale TV” from the menu. Call (818) 548-4013 for program schedules. DVDs of the
 proceedings are available for purchase in the City Clerk's Office. Meetings are also archived on the
 City Website for viewing anytime at glendaleca.gov/agendas. Audit Reports are available for
 viewing at https://www.glendaleca.gov/government/departments/finance/audit/audit-reports. If you
 have any question about matters on the agenda, or requests for assistance, please call Finance at
 (818) 548-2085 during regular business hours.
  PLEASE TURN OFF CELLULAR PHONES WHILE INSIDE THE MEETING ROOM.
 In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) of 1990, auxiliary hearing aids, sign
 language translation, and Braille transcripts are available upon request. Assisted listening devices
 are available same-day upon request. At least 48 hours (or two business days) notice is required
 for requests regarding sign language translation and Braille transcription services. All documents
 related to open session items on this agenda that are received less than 72 hours prior to this
 meeting, and are public records, will be available for review in the Office of the City Clerk, 613 E.
 Broadway, RM 110, Glendale, CA 91206.
 Translation services are provided for meetings through the use of bilingual staff for speakers who
 wish to utilize the service as available. Speakers should state their request by contacting the City
 Clerk’s office at (818) 548-2090, at least 24 hours prior to the scheduled meeting. Please specify
 the language for which you require translation. The exclusive use of City provided interpreters is not
 required and persons are welcome to use their own interpreter or speak in their native language.

  JULY 29, 2021 AT 2:00 PM

To help slow the transmission of COVID-19, and protect the health and safety of the community, City
Council, as well as Board & Commission meetings, will continue to be closed to the public for in-
person attendance.

The public is encouraged to watch and participate from the safety of their homes to practice social
distancing.

The meetings can be viewed:
   • On local cable Charter Cable Channel 6 and AT&T U-verse Channel 99.
  • Streaming in high definition online at glendaleca.gov/live, YouTube.com/myglendale, and a free
  app called Screenweave on Apple TV, Roku, and Amazon Fire devices. Choose “Glendale
  TV” from the menu.

For public comments and questions during the meeting, call (818) 937-8100. City staff will be
submitting these questions and comments in real time to the appropriate person during the Glendale
Audit Committee meeting.

1. ROLL CALL
2. BUSINESS AGENDA
  a. Report of Recording Secretary, re: Posting of Agenda
  The Agenda for the July 29, 2021 Audit Committee Meeting was posted on July 26, 2021 on
  the bulletin board outside City Hall.
3. ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
  Discussion is limited to items not a part of this agenda. Each speaker is allowed 3 minutes. The
  Committee may question or respond to the speaker but there will be no debate or decision.
  The Audit Committee Chair may refer the matter to staff for investigation and report.
4. APPROVAL OF MINUTES
  a. Minutes of the Audit Committee meeting held on April 29, 2021
5. ACTION ITEMS
  a. Election of Audit Committee Chair
  b. Election of Audit Committee Secretary
  c. Annual Report to City Council
6. REPORTS - INFORMATION
  a. Internal Audit Activity Report as of 6/30/2021 – Jessie Zhang, Internal Audit Manager
  b. FY 2020-21 Audit Work Plan Review and Proposed FY 2021-22 Audit Work Plan
  – Jessie Zhang, Internal Audit Manager
  c. Report from CliftonLarsonAllen, LLP on the Audit of FY ended June 30, 2021
  – Theresa Clark, Finance Accounting Manager
7. AUDIT COMMITTEE/STAFF COMMENTS
8. NEW BUSINESS
9. ADJOURNMENT

CITY OF GLENDALE
  AUDIT COMMITTEE MINUTES
  July 29, 2021

Due to the ongoing COVID-19 pandemic, social distancing requirements, and health
recommendations from LA County Public Health Department, this meeting was conducted
remotely and live at the City Council Chambers.

1.  ROLL CALL: 2:00 PM

  Present:  Zareh Amirian, Ed Khashadourian, Alex Parajon

2.  BUSINESS AGENDA:

  A. Posting of Agenda

  The Agenda for the Audit Committee meeting of July 29, 2021 was posted on Monday,
  July 26, 2021 on the Bulletin Board outside City Hall and posted on the City’s website.

3.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS:

  None.

4.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES:

  A. Minutes of the Audit Committee meeting held on April 29, 2021

  Moved: Ed Khashadourian Second: Alex Parajon

  Vote as follows:

  Ayes: Ed Khashadourian, Alex Parajon, and Zareh Amirian

  Noes:

5.  ACTION ITEMS:

  A. Election of Audit Committee Chair

  Nomination: Zareh Amirian

  Moved: Alex Parajon Second: Ed Khashadourian

  Vote as follows:

  Ayes: Ed Khashadourian, Alex Parajon, and Zareh Amirian

  1
   Noes:

  B. Election of Audit Committee Secretary

  Nomination: Ms. Ani Antanesyan

  Moved: Zareh Amirian Second: Alex Parajon

  Vote as follows:

  Ayes: Ed Khashadourian, Alex Parajon, and Zareh Amirian

  Noes:

  C. Annual Report to City Council

  Chairman Amirian presented the Annual Report to City Council dated July 29, 2021.

  Moved: Ed Khashadourian Second: Alex Parajon

  Vote as follows:

  Ayes: Ed Khashadourian, Alex Parajon, and Zareh Amirian

  Noes:

6.  REPORTS – INFORMATION:

  Chairman Amirian requested that item 6C be taken out of order and presented first.

  C. Report from CliftonLarsonAllen, LLP on the Audit of FY ended June 30, 2021 –
  Theresa Clark, Finance Accounting Manager

  Ms. Theresa Clark, Accounting Manager introduced the City’s external auditor,
  CliftonLarsonAllen, LLP to the Audit Committee and noted that it is their second year
  with the City.

  Next, she introduced Ms. Daphne Munoz, Engagement Partner from
  CliftonLarsonAllen LLP, who made a more detailed presentation on the audit results.

  A. Internal Audit Activity Report as of 06/30/2021 – Jessie Zhang, Internal Audit
  Manager

  Ms. Jessie Zhang, Internal Audit Manager, provided a report to the Audit Committee
  on the Internal Audit activity for the quarter ended on July 30, 2021. Ms. Ani
  Antanesyan, Internal Auditor, presented on the GWP Call Center Productivity
  Analysis Before and During COVID-19 Analysis. Ms. Antanesyan, Mr. John
  Takhtalian, Deputy City Manager, and Ms. Tami Vallier, Glendale Water and Power
  Customer Service Administrator, answered questions from the Committee members.

  2
   Mr. Sameel Salim, Senior Internal Auditor, made a presentation on the PCI
  Compliance Audit. Mr. Salim answered questions from the Committee members.

  Next, Ms. Natalie Minami-Valdivia, Senior Internal Auditor, made a presentation on
  the Risk Management Function Research and Staffing Analysis. Ms. Natalie Minami-
  Valdivia answered questions from the Committee members.

  After the audit presentations, Ms. Zhang continued presenting her activity report for
  the quarter. She covered projects in progress, continuous audits, quarterly follow-up
  status on outstanding audit issues, and advisory services and answered questions
  from the Committee members.

  B. FY 2020-21 Audit Work Plan Review and Proposed FY 2021-22 Audit Work Plan
  – Jessie Zhang, Internal Audit Manager

  Ms. Zhang, Internal Audit Manager, presented the FY 2020-21 Audit Work Plan
  Review and Proposed FY 2021-22 Audit Work Plan. Ms. Zhang answered questions
  from the Committee members. Audit Committee Member Ed Khashadourian noted
  that he would be interested to see an audit of the City’s building permit process and
  its fee structure focusing on staff productivity, process redundancies and where
  efficiencies can be gained to reduce permit clearance times.

  Chairman Amirian remarked on the transition of the Internal Audit division from the
  recent restructuring of the Innovation, Performance and Audit by incorporating
  Internal Audit in Finance and the Innovation and Performance elements in the City
  Manager’s Office.

7.  AUDIT COMMITTEE/STAFF COMMENTS:

  Chairman Amirian thanked Internal Audit for the information that is provided during
  meetings and that he looks forward to the continued evolution of the division.

8.  NEW BUSINESS:

  None.

9.  ADJOURNMENT:

  Moved: Ed Khashadourian  Second: Alex Parajon

  Adjournment at 4:23 PM
